_offices_note: Branches in display order. A branch with "pending": true has no published contact details yet: it is listed by city only, never used for WhatsApp routing, forms, footer contacts or structured data. To publish one, remove "pending" and add consultant, initials, address, phones, wa, wa_greeting, email and map_query like the complete entries.
